documents.population: International applicants to Chinese-taught undergraduate programmes
documents.cycle_stated: List of 2026 SJTU Undergraduate Program in Chinese for International Students
documents.notes: 'SJTU Undergraduate Programs in Chinese for International Students' (List of 2026 programmes; application December 2025 - March 2026; term begins September 2026): the latest SJTU list on 2026-10-19, '2026' is the cycle label. Not drafted (no vocabulary kind): Chinese proficiency proof (HSK 5 200+ or HSK 6 180+, or equivalent), other supporting documents. Standardized international test scores or national examination results (SAT, AP, ACT, A-Level, IB, UEC; a written explanation if unavailable) are also listed; entrance_test is drafted as the CSCA score. Regular Round applicants also sit the SJTU International Undergraduate Entrance Exam.

items.quote: Fill out the application form completely and upload all required application materials as specified.
High school transcript (covering all courses completed during high school).
Prospective graduates must provide a pre-graduation certificate issued by their school and obtain their high school diploma before enrollment.
Test score of the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA)
English language proficiency proof, with at least one of the following materials required: (1) TOEFL scores (code: D070). (2) IELTS scores.
items.condition: English proficiency shown by a TOEFL/IELTS score rather than other proof (proof of English native speaker, English language study certificates)
